approach.service_description: The ENC_Approach map service displays data compiled for ENC products with a scale range of 1:50,001 and 1:150,000. The ENC data used within this application will be updated weekly. This map service is not intended for navigation purpose.

coastal.service_description: The ENC_Coastal map service displays ENC data within the scale range of 1:150,001 and 1:600,000.  The ENC data will be updated weekly.  This map service is not intended for navigation purpose.

general.service_description: The ENC_General map service displays ENC data within the scale range of 1:600,001 and 1:1,500,000.  The ENC data will be updated weekly.  This map service is not intended for navigation purpose.

harbour.service_description: The ENC_Harbour map service displays data compiled for ENC products with a scale range of 1:5,000 and 1:50,000. The ENC data used within this application will be updated weekly. This map service is not intended for navigation purpose.

overview.service_description: The ENC_Overview map service displays data compiled for ENC products with a scale ratio of 1:1,500,001 or smaller. The ENC data used within this application will be updated weekly. This map service is not intended for navigation purpose.

source_product: NOAA ENC Direct weekly scale-specific ArcGIS MapServer
unknown_policy: No returned coverage feature means unknown; never infer water.
